outcome: Pattern of drug use during delivery hospitalization
Number of drugs used by mothers
cohort: 1,392 women hospitalized for delivery in the urban area of Pelotas, Brazil, as part of the 2015 Pelotas births cohort.
finding: Drug use during delivery hospitalization was high, with all women receiving at least one drug, and cesarean delivery and epidural anesthesia being the main factors associated with higher drug consumption.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with higher use of anti-infective agents and drugs acting on the cardiovascular and respiratory systems.
